bullets: Develop working knowledge of the Prospera and Renasight products, including the technology, clinical utility, customer workflows, and operational processes.
Serve as an initial point of contact for product and case-related questions from field and internal teams, routing and escalating issues as appropriate.
Support clinical study-related activities by partnering with Clinical Operations and Operations teams to address questions and track operational needs over time.
Monitor case progress and turnaround time on a regular basis, identify delayed or at-risk cases, and work with Operations and Laboratory partners to move them forward.
Provide high-touch support for priority or sensitive cases to help ensure a positive customer experience.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Sales, Marketing & Business Solutions

bullets: Own the strategy, roadmap, and backlog for Sales and Marketing platforms, with Salesforce as the system of record and primary user-facing interaction mode for commercial workflows
Partner with Sales & Marketing to turn business needs into clear requirements (PRDs, user stories, user flows) and prioritize them by value, effort, and platform impact
Manage the integration points between CRM and marketing automation, including lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and attribution
Lead quarterly and annual planning (intake, prioritization, and governance processes) with technical and cross-functional stakeholders so every initiative is visible, sequenced…
Work with engineering and architecture on data model, integration, and build vs. buy vs. configure decisions
